remarks: Prepare to be captivated. Downtown Greenwich's newest 4 bedroom luxury rental townhomes are poised to redefine downtown living. Nestled just off Greenwich Avenue, these residences, crafted by an award-winning local builder and meticulously managed, offer the ultimate carefree lifestyle. Imagine expansive, open floor plans, perfect for grand entertaining, gourmet kitchens and private outdoor sanctuaries. Ascend to the second floor and discover a sumptuous primary suite, an elegant ensuite bedroom, and convenient laundry facilities. Choose from 1 or 2 car garage options, enjoy the luxury of a private elevator spanning all floors, and a formal mudroom to keep things organized. The flexible lower level boasts a bonus room, full bath, and bedroom. A breathtaking third-floor bedroom and access to your own private rooftop deck, complete with optional pool and outdoor kitchen! This isn't just a rental; it's a statement. Secure your slice of Greenwich paradise today
